sub_items.description: Video clip of TPUSA UGA staff (Grant Tyler, Caroline) promoting Erika Kirk and JD Vance at Akins Ford Arena, posted ~50 minutes before doors opened.
Andrew Kolvet on-stage announcement that Erika Kirk would not appear, citing "very serious threats."
JD Vance on-stage response defending Erika Kirk against criticism of her grief.
Fox News interview clip in which Andrew Kolvet states TPUSA security team "could not guarantee" Erika's safety and references her children being "one parent away from being orphans."

artifacts.bundle_name: Andrew Kolvet Charlie Kirk Show Interview

sub_items.description: Audio/video clip of Andrew Kolvet on Charlie Kirk's show describing the cancellation as tied to monitored "online chatter," doxing of travel, and inability of security to guarantee safety.
Tweet attributed to Daily Wire summarizing a TPUSA official's account: travel-itinerary doxing, multiple direct threats, and chief concern over the travel portion rather than the venue.
Erika Kirk X post stating she was "looking forward to tonight's event" but cancelled because she takes her "security team's recommendations extremely seriously."

artifacts.bundle_name: Erika Kirk Jesse Watters Interview Clip

sub_items.description: Clip of Erika Kirk on Jesse Watters stating she is not afraid because threats would simply send her "to heaven sooner to be with my husband."
Email/text "Parent Alert" sent Monday 2026-04-13 cancelling the Tuesday 2026-04-14 high-school event, citing "scheduling complications." The notice references a date of "September 14th."

artifacts.bundle_name: Pinnacle High School Parent Facebook Chat

sub_items.description: Screenshot of a Pinnacle High School (Phoenix, AZ) parent-organized Facebook chat calling Erika Kirk's appearance "highly inappropriate and a safety risk" and urging parents to call kids out of school.
Tweet from MS Now reporter Jake Trailer reporting that the Akins Ford Arena was "less than 25% filled" for the VP event, with attached venue footage.

Instagram/X video posted by Victor Marx in response to Candace Owens' previous episode, captioned "Well, all righty then. Love you, Candace. Let me know when you want me to come on the show. Praying for you."

artifacts.bundle_name: Candace Owens Public Comment Reply to Victor Marx

sub_items.description: Candace Owens' public Instagram comment beneath Marx's video, inviting Marx to appear with Corby Hall and confirming Hall's agreement.

artifacts.bundle_name: Candace Owens DM to Victor Marx

sub_items.description: Candace Owens' private DM to Victor Marx requesting a phone number to set up an on-air joint appearance with Corby Hall; states no read receipt observed prior to air.

Marcus Wada's biographical page on the TPUSA website identifying him as "director of strategy of productions," listing film/TV credits including Miss Universe and TPUSA documentaries "Border Battle" and "The Great Global Reset."

Website of Marcus Wada's brother's consulting firm listing "Industry Areas" including national border security, money laundering, human trafficking, sex trafficking, firearms and ammunition, and controlled substances.
Verbal report from unnamed current and former TPUSA employees stating that Marcus Wada openly discusses past involvement in trafficking arms in Poland and is closely associated with Andrew Kolvet.

claims.label: Erika Kirk Scheduled to Appear at UGA with VP JD Vance
claims.claim: Erika Kirk was scheduled to appear alongside Vice President JD Vance at the University of Georgia event on 2026-04-14.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm via TPUSA event listing, UGA/Akins Ford Arena booking records, and contemporaneous press releases.

claims.label: UGA TPUSA Staff Uninformed of Erika's Absence
claims.claim: TPUSA UGA event staff (Grant Tyler, Caroline) were not informed of Erika Kirk's absence until approximately 50 minutes before doors opened, as evidenced by their posted promotion video.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference social-media post timestamps against TPUSA internal communication records; obtain statements from named staff.

claims.label: Andrew Kolvet Cited Security Threats as Reason for Erika's UGA No-Show
claims.claim: Andrew Kolvet announced on stage at the UGA event that Erika Kirk was absent due to "very serious threats" against her.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain audio/video of the announcement; verify whether the announcement was scripted or extemporaneous.

claims.label: TPUSA Security Team Declined to Guarantee Erika's Safety
claims.claim: Andrew Kolvet stated on Fox News that TPUSA's security team told the organization "we cannot guarantee your safety" regarding Erika Kirk.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full Fox News segment; identify which TPUSA security contractor is referenced.

claims.label: Kolvet Retroactively Reclassified High School Cancellation as Security-Driven
claims.claim: Andrew Kolvet stated on Charlie Kirk's show that the Monday high school event was also cancelled due to "increased online chatter" being monitored by TPUSA security.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare against the originally issued parent-alert notice (A-1972.1); determine whether the explanation was issued contemporaneously or after public criticism.

claims.label: Daily Wire Reported Travel Doxing and Direct Threats
claims.claim: The Daily Wire reported, citing a TPUSA official, that Erika Kirk's travel itinerary was being doxed, that multiple direct threats were made, and that the chief security concern was the travel portion.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the named TPUSA official cited by Daily Wire; verify any law-enforcement reports referenced.

claims.label: Erika Kirk Stated Cancellation Followed Security Team Recommendation
claims.claim: Erika Kirk posted on X that she cancelled because she "takes [her] security team's recommendations extremely seriously."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain timestamp of post relative to the on-stage announcement; verify whether the post was authored by Kirk personally.

claims.label: Erika Kirk Stated She Feels Safe and Fears Nothing in Jesse Watters Interview
claims.claim: Erika Kirk stated on Jesse Watters that she does not feel threatened and that any attempt would simply send her "to heaven sooner."
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm full interview date and air date; verify whether the clip presented is representative of the full exchange.

claims.label: UGA High School Event Cancelled Monday Citing "Scheduling Complications"
claims.claim: TPUSA cancelled a Monday 2026-04-13 high school event scheduled for Tuesday 2026-04-14, citing "scheduling complications" rather than security threats.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original email/text from TPUSA to the school; interview named administrators.

claims.label: Parents and Teachers Organizing Boycott of Erika Kirk at Pinnacle High School
claims.claim: Parents and at least one teacher are organizing a walkout/boycott of Erika Kirk's appearance at Pinnacle High School in Phoenix, citing safety concerns.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm event status with Pinnacle High School administration; obtain school district statement.

claims.label: UGA High School Cancellation Email References "September 14th"
claims.claim: The parent-alert email canceling the Georgia high school event referenced a scheduled date of "September 14th," inconsistent with the actual event date of April 14, 2026.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain original email to determine whether "September" is a transcription/OCR artifact or a genuine content error.

claims.label: Akins Ford Arena Less Than 25% Filled for VP Event
claims.claim: MS Now reporter Jake Trailer reported that Akins Ford Arena was less than 25% filled for the Vice President's appearance.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference with venue ticket-issuing records and TPUSA promotion metrics.

claims.label: Victor Marx Posted Video Response on Instagram/X
claims.claim: Victor Marx posted a short video response on Instagram and X in reply to Candace Owens' prior episode, captioned "Well, all righty then. Love you, Candace."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify post URL, timestamp, and whether the post has since been deleted or edited.

claims.label: Candace Owens Invited Victor Marx to Appear with Corby Hall
claims.claim: Candace Owens publicly replied beneath Marx's post inviting him to appear on her show together with Corby Hall; Hall reportedly agreed.
claims.investigative_direction: Capture timestamped screenshots of the comment thread before any deletion.

claims.label: Candace Owens DM'd Victor Marx Privately Requesting a Phone Number
claims.claim: Candace Owens sent a private DM to Victor Marx requesting his phone number to schedule a joint appearance; as of air no read receipt had been observed.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify DM timestamp; await Marx's response or non-response.

claims.label: Marcus Wada Identified as TPUSA Director of Strategy of Productions
claims.claim: The TPUSA website bio identifies Marcus Wada as "director of strategy of productions."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain archived copies of the TPUSA bio page; verify against TPUSA staff directory and IRS Form 990 disclosures.

claims.label: Marcus Wada TPUSA Bio Lists Miss Universe and TPUSA Documentaries
claims.claim: Marcus Wada's TPUSA bio lists credits on Miss Universe and TPUSA documentaries "Border Battle" and "The Great Global Reset."
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference against IMDb / production credits; verify production dates and roles.

claims.label: Marcus Wada's Brother's Consulting Firm Lists Trafficking Among Industry Areas
claims.claim: The consulting firm associated with Marcus Wada's brother lists industry areas including human trafficking, sex trafficking, firearms and ammunition, money laundering, and controlled substances.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain full webpage capture; identify the firm and confirm the family relationship through independent records.

claims.label: Erika Kirk's Public Stance Reversed from Fearlessness to Security-Based Cancellation
claims.claim: Erika Kirk's stated public position shifted from declaring fearlessness in the earlier Jesse Watters interview to citing her security team's recommendations when canceling the UGA event.
claims.investigative_direction: Compile chronology of Kirk's public statements on personal safety; identify whether a specific triggering event is documented.

claims.label: Marcus Wada Reportedly Discusses Past Arms Trafficking in Poland
claims.claim: Per unnamed current and former TPUSA employees, Marcus Wada openly discusses past involvement in arms trafficking in Poland and is described as close to Andrew Kolvet.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify at least one named corroborating source; cross-reference LinkedIn history (A-1976.1) for prior Poland-based employment.

claims.label: TPUSA Public Explanation Sequence Internally Inconsistent
claims.claim: TPUSA's public explanation of the UGA no-show evolved across at least five artifacts (stage announcement, Fox News interview, Charlie Kirk show interview, Daily Wire tweet, Erika Kirk X post) and contained internal inconsistencies regarding whether the high school event shared the same rationale.
claims.investigative_direction: Construct a chronological explanation map; identify the originator of each stated rationale and any superseding statements.

claims.label: JD Vance Defended Erika Kirk Against Criticism at UGA Event
claims.claim: Vice President JD Vance stated on stage at the UGA event that criticizing Erika Kirk over her grieving was "the most preposterous thing I've seen in a very long time" in politics.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain full transcript of Vance's remarks; verify whether the statement was prepared or responsive to Andrew Kolvet's prompt.
